name: getsockname
synopsis: int getsockname(int sockfd, struct sockaddr *restrict addr, socklen_t *restrict addrlen);
description: getsockname() retrieves the current address to which a socket is bound and stores it in the provided buffer. The addrlen parameter must be initialized with the buffer size and is updated with the actual address size on return. If the buffer is too small, the address is truncated.

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer where the socket address is stored

parameters.name: addrlen
parameters.description: Pointer to the size of the addr buffer, which is updated with the actual size on return

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The argument sockfd is not a valid file descriptor
The addr argument points to memory not in a valid part of the process address space
Insufficient resources were available in the system to perform the operation
The file descriptor sockfd does not refer to a socket
